data.title: TOTO Japan Classic 2024
data.description: TOTO LTD. (Headquarters: Kitakyushu City, Fukuoka Prefecture; President: Noriaki Kiyota) is pleased to announce its continued sponsorship this year of the Japan Classic, a US Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA) official tournament, being held at Seta Golf Course (North Course) in Otsu, Shiga Prefecture, starting Thursday, October 31. This year marks the 50th anniversary of the Japan Classic, a highly prestigious tournament with an illustrious tradition, and the 10th year of TOTO’s special sponsorship.
data.content:
OTO LTD. (Headquarters: Kitakyushu City, Fukuoka Prefecture; President: Noriaki Kiyota) is pleased to announce its continued sponsorship this year of the Japan Classic, a US Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA) official tournament, being held at Seta Golf Course (North Course) in Otsu, Shiga Prefecture, starting Thursday, October 31. This year marks the 50th anniversary of the Japan Classic, a highly prestigious tournament with an illustrious tradition, and the 10th year of TOTO’s special sponsorship.


The US Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA) is an organization with a long history, founded in 1950. It launched its activities in Japan in 1973, as the LPGA Japan Golf Classic. This year, too, 43 players*1 from 13 countries worldwide will participate alongside 35 players from Japan*2. The tournament is the only official LPGA tournament in Japan, where fans can watch world-class golfers play.


In addition, this year, the Japan Ladies Professional Golf Association will invite junior high school students from the host city and surrounding areas to watch the competition, engage in volunteer work at the tournament, and experience snap golf, with the aims of further increasing the popularity of golf as a sport and contributing to the local community. A charity auction will also be held with players participating since 2020.


Through this tournament, TOTO will seek to further expand the circle of volunteer activities and social contribution activities rooted in local communities, while sharing in the excitement with all sports fans, identifying with them, and valuing bonds with society. Going forward, TOTO will continue to promote and support golf and various other sports.


For more information, feel free to visit: toto-japan-classic.com/en

data.title: NEOREST Celebrates its 30th Anniversary
data.description: NEOREST, the top-class series of toilets manufactured and marketed by TOTO LTD. (Headquarters: Kitakyushu, Fukuoka Prefecture; President: Noriaki Kiyota), celebrated the 30th anniversary of its launch on April 1, 2023.
data.thumb: /assets/img/content/news/anniversary/NEOREST Celebrates its 30th Anniversary content big pic.jpeg
data.content:
NEOREST, the top-class series of toilets manufactured and marketed by TOTO LTD. (Headquarters: Kitakyushu, Fukuoka Prefecture; President: Noriaki Kiyota), celebrated the 30th anniversary of its launch on April 1, 2023.

NEOREST, a coined word combining neo and restroom, was first launched on April 1, 1993 as the futuregeneration toilet for the creation of bathroom. Since then, the NEOREST series has been the top class of TOTO toilets, establishing a series of new common practices for toilets redefining both technology and design. The NEOREST series has created new culture of bathrooms.





All ideas come from a human being’s fundamental, physiological function, relieving oneself. While ensuring that increased hygiene and comfort are compatible with consideration for the environment as indicated by the reduction of water and electricity usage, TOTO’s cutting-edge technologies including EWATER+, TORNADO FLUSH and CEFIONTECT have been introduced in the NEOREST series.

Consistently since the first NEOREST, the series has had a tank-less design. This creates a low-silhouette design which has expanded the possibilities for designing spaces in Japanese restrooms and also overseas bathrooms.

Based on the brand message, Pure Luxury, NEOREST will continue to evolve and remain the one and only brand leading toilets around the world as it makes restrooms more than spaces for people to relieve themselves —— it is going to be the space for healthily keeping the heart and mind in good order and even enriching the heart.
